name: Caesar Raphael
source:
Likes: You
Dislikes: Turning into Piggy
Hobby: Cooking
Skill: Becoming a friend with everybody

"You know how much I feel for you."

Alfonse: A man with a cheerful character and charming smiles, who has studied in Hinomoto...
Yup, that's Caesar!
Because of the curse he has, kisses transform him into a pig. This curse is caused by his ancestor, the House of Baroque. Zeus is the one who enjoys it the most and always makes fun of him...
Poor Caesar...
Caesar is always cheerful but he seems to be in deep in thought sometimes...
I wonder what is hidden under that happy smile...

[Official in-game description]
